events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with the US and its allies involved in military operations. This has led to increased tensions in the Middle East and a rise in oil prices. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential for further escalation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is expected to lead to increased volatility in the markets, with potential for a rise in oil prices and a decline in stock prices. Buying the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could provide a hedge against potential losses, while shorting the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) could provide a profit from the potential decline in oil prices.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict shows signs of de-escalation
